hints.title: Digit Mask Representation
hints.text: Represent the set of unique decimal digits in each node value as a 10-bit integer mask.

hints.title: Subtree DP State
hints.text: For each node, compute a mapping from combined digit masks to the maximum accumulated score in its subtree.

hints.title: Disjoint Mask Merging
hints.text: When combining child subtree results, verify that the bitwise intersection of digit masks is empty.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
D: number of distinct decimal digits (D <= 10)
complexity.notes: Tree DP combining disjoint bitmasks with maximum 1024 states per node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all combinations of connected subgraphs without digit state compression is intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing best sums per digit mask prunes redundant lower-value subtree subsets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formulate subtree DP combining disjoint digit masks using bitwise operations.
